architecture.carrier: Unmodified mine_relay feature extractors and fusion computations, selectable logits/inject/relay
architecture.appearance: Shared RGB encoder, separate appearance decoder copied from the randomly initialized carrier decoder before training
architecture.selection: p_final = (1-g) * p_rgb + g * p_fused, implemented with stable logaddexp
architecture.whole_depth_absent: Exactly select the appearance prediction; not an accuracy guarantee
architecture.router_inputs: Detached expert probabilities, absolute disagreement, two entropies, current coverage and brightness; no labels
architecture.router_resolution: First-stage feature grid, bilinear upsampling of routing logits
architecture.utility_target: sigmoid((NLL_rgb(y) - NLL_fused(y)) / 0.5), detached; training labels only
architecture.utility_scope: Pixels with semantic labels in images with at least one depth observation; natural holes may have semantic supervision
architecture.missing_depth_losses: Exclude CE_fused, CE_geo and BCE_router for fully absent depth; retain final and RGB supervision
architecture.ignored_pixels: Label 255 excluded; empty terms contribute zero

limitations: Not a verified improvement or a finalized paper method
The RGB encoder is shared and receives multiple objectives; the appearance branch is not fully isolated from multimodal learning
A probability mixture cannot guarantee choosing the correct expert when labels are unavailable
Synthetic correctness checks do not establish training stability or generalization
Use the independent mine_selective entry points; the frozen mine_relay trainer does not implement this candidate
Full-size GPU readiness and launch supervision have passed; that does not establish accuracy, generalization, or bitwise CUDA replay
Whole-image missing depth has an exact RGB-output fallback; local depth holes do not have a hard per-pixel fallback
Current paired training corrupts depth by holes or complete dropout, not the evaluation-time RGB darkening or depth-noise conditions
Rare-class crop sampling is disabled; current rare-class handling is shared clipped inverse-frequency weighting
Loss coefficients are not renormalized when the depth-dependent terms are masked out
